It’s not just our adherence to quality standards that sets us apart; it’s also our capabilities. Whatever your application, we provide products for a variety of applications, and some of our capabilities include engineering, testing & inspection, manufacturing, prototyping, and the use of a wide range of materials.
If you have a project in mind, we have a very skilled engineering team who are willing to meet you at your level and provide exactly what your application requires. Our testing and inspection process guarantees that you receive the highest possible quality product, every time.

Having superior equipment is key to our success and to maintain consistent, repeatable, and exact part manufacturing requires keeping this equipment running at its best. Through our Total Production Maintenance program (TPM) our machines are regularly maintained to achieve reliable, maximum manufacturing potential.
Our CNC Milling and Turning capabilities makes us an industry leader in custom manufacturing capabilities.
Boasting the best equipment in the industry with many years of experience means you can rely on us to deliver precisely what you need, every time. If you have high-volume requirements, we have the answer — our manual surface grinding machines are made for just that.

The basic building block of all Aircraft Cable and Wire Ropes, strand provides the foundation of performance and durability regardless of material, industry, or application.
